headline: In Battle to Use ‘Ms.,’ Gloria Steinem Had to Fight The New York Times
context: In the 1970s, Ms. Steinem confronted the newspaper’s executive editor about the honorific in an exchange of letters, pressing it to use the alternative to Miss or Mrs.
